title: Spatiotemporal images, religious and existential orientation in the poetry of Ibn Ḥazm al‑Andalusī (456 AH)
core_idea: To analyze Ibn Ḥazm's spatiotemporal poetic images as an alternative model to his prose for revealing his religious visions and existential theories, investigating how relations between image, time, and place reflect his ideology under the influence of Islamic culture and Greek philosophy using stylistic and cultural criticism.
tldr: A stylistic and cultural‑critical study examining how image, time, and place in Ibn Ḥazm's poetry serve as a means to articulate his religious and existential orientations shaped by Islamic culture and Greek thought.
